title: CCP Boeing CST-100 Starliner OFT Rollout Remarks
description: Boeing is rolling out the CST-100 Starliner spacecraft for NASA's Orbital Flight Test to the International Space Station. This uncrewed flight is part of the certification efforts with NASA's Commercial Crew Program.

via: the NASA Image and Video Library
